source: Gemini 3.8 flash-high via agy, 2026-10-20, from model knowledge only, UNVERIFIED hints

gotchas.signal: 400 Bad Request: Keys for idempotent requests cannot be reused with differing parameters
gotchas.claim: Reusing an Idempotency-Key header with a mutated request payload causes immediate rejection instead of returning the original result.
gotchas.fix_hint: Generate a unique UUID per distinct request payload rather than caching keys across mutation attempts.

gotchas.claim: Stripe webhook verification rejects payloads if the server clock drifts more than 300 seconds from Stripe's timestamp.
gotchas.fix_hint: Synchronize host system clocks via NTP and allow a small tolerance window in signature verification code.

gotchas.signal: 403 Forbidden: Request forbidden by administrative rules. Please make sure your request has a User-Agent header
gotchas.claim: GitHub API unconditionally rejects requests lacking a User-Agent header.
gotchas.fix_hint: Set a descriptive User-Agent header with your app or username on every HTTP request.

gotchas.signal: 403 Forbidden: You have exceeded a secondary rate limit
gotchas.claim: Rapid concurrent requests trigger secondary rate limits even when primary hourly quotas are nearly untouched.
gotchas.fix_hint: Serialize write requests and implement exponential backoff honoring the Retry-After header.

gotchas.claim: Slack drops Event Subscriptions if the endpoint does not echo back the challenge parameter in plaintext or JSON within 3 seconds.
gotchas.fix_hint: Respond immediately with the raw challenge value upon receiving url_verification events.

gotchas.claim: Slack returns HTTP 200 with an error object inside the body when the bot attempts actions in channels it has not joined.
gotchas.fix_hint: Inspect the ok boolean in response bodies and invoke conversations.join before posting.

gotchas.claim: OpenAI Server-Sent Events streams terminate with a non-JSON data: [DONE] string that breaks standard JSON decoders.
gotchas.fix_hint: Check for the [DONE] sentinel string before passing stream chunk buffers to JSON.parse.

gotchas.signal: 429 Too Many Requests: rate_limit_exceeded (TPM vs RPM)
gotchas.claim: Tokens-per-minute (TPM) limits are frequently exhausted by large prompt contexts before requests-per-minute (RPM) limits are hit.
gotchas.fix_hint: Track estimated prompt and completion tokens client-side and throttle requests based on TPM.

gotchas.claim: Anthropic API rejects requests that do not specify the anthropic-version header.
gotchas.fix_hint: Add anthropic-version: 2023-06-01 to your default request headers.

gotchas.signal: 400 Bad Request: messages: each tool_result block must have a corresponding tool_use block
gotchas.claim: Submitting a tool_result with an invalid, out-of-order, or missing tool_use_id fails validation immediately.
gotchas.fix_hint: Ensure tool_result blocks strictly mirror preceding assistant tool_use IDs in consecutive sequence.

gotchas.claim: When safety filters trigger, Gemini returns HTTP 200 with no text parts, causing IndexError or null pointer exceptions in client code.
gotchas.fix_hint: Inspect candidates[0].finishReason before accessing content parts.

gotchas.claim: Gemini silently blocks generation when the model attempts to emit copyrighted or verbatim source training text.
gotchas.fix_hint: Catch RECITATION finish reasons and prompt the model to synthesize or summarize instead of quoting.

gotchas.signal: 400 Bad Request: body failed validation: ... length should be <= 2000
gotchas.claim: Notion rejects any rich text object whose text content exceeds 2000 characters.
gotchas.fix_hint: Split long text strings into chunks of 2000 characters across multiple rich text objects.

gotchas.claim: Appending block children in Notion fails if more than 100 blocks are submitted in a single request.
gotchas.fix_hint: Batch block creation into slices of 100 blocks maximum.

gotchas.signal: 429 Too Many Requests: TEN_SECOND_ROLLING limit exceeded
gotchas.claim: HubSpot enforces a burst limit of 100 requests per 10 seconds alongside daily quotas.
gotchas.fix_hint: Implement a token bucket rate limiter to smooth bursts below 10 requests per second.

gotchas.signal: 400 Bad Request: Property names must be lowercase
gotchas.claim: HubSpot custom property API names are strictly lowercase even if created with mixed casing in the UI.
gotchas.fix_hint: Normalize all HubSpot property internal names to lowercase in API requests.

gotchas.claim: Salesforce access tokens expire independently of active user sessions without prior HTTP warning.
gotchas.fix_hint: Refresh the OAuth token automatically upon encountering INVALID_SESSION_ID and replay the call.

gotchas.claim: Salesforce SOQL query pagination returns relative URLs in nextRecordsUrl rather than absolute URLs.
gotchas.fix_hint: Prepend your Salesforce instance base URL to nextRecordsUrl when retrieving remaining records.

gotchas.claim: Trial accounts cannot send SMS to arbitrary numbers until the destination number is verified in the console.
gotchas.fix_hint: Verify recipient phone numbers in the Twilio console or upgrade to a paid account.

gotchas.signal: Silent SMS split / UCS-2 encoding cost spike
gotchas.claim: Including a single emoji switches SMS encoding from GSM-7 (160 chars) to UCS-2 (70 chars), multiplying segment counts silently.
gotchas.fix_hint: Strip non-GSM characters or calculate segment boundaries prior to dispatch.

gotchas.signal: 403 Forbidden: The from address does not match a verified Sender Identity
gotchas.claim: SendGrid blocks outgoing mail if the sender email domain or address is not explicitly verified.
gotchas.fix_hint: Complete Single Sender Verification or Domain Authentication before calling /v3/mail/send.

gotchas.claim: SendGrid returns 202 Accepted even if the recipient is on an internal bounce or unsubscribe suppression list.
gotchas.fix_hint: Check the suppression list APIs or consume Event Webhooks to detect undelivered messages.

gotchas.signal: 403 Forbidden: You can only send testing emails to your own email address
gotchas.claim: Resend sandbox API keys with onboarding domains can only deliver mail to the account owner's email.
gotchas.fix_hint: Verify a custom domain in Resend before targeting external recipient addresses.

gotchas.claim: Discord interaction webhooks expire after 3 seconds if not acknowledged with an initial deferred or immediate response.
gotchas.fix_hint: Send an interaction response type 5 (deferred channel message) within 3000ms before doing heavy work.

gotchas.claim: Bots receive empty strings for message text unless the Message Content Privileged Intent is enabled.
gotchas.fix_hint: Toggle the Message Content Intent under your bot's Developer Portal settings.

gotchas.signal: 409 Conflict: can't use getUpdates method while webhook is active
gotchas.claim: Calling getUpdates while a webhook is registered immediately fails with HTTP 409.
gotchas.fix_hint: Call deleteWebhook before attempting long-polling with getUpdates.

gotchas.claim: Telegram MarkdownV2 mode requires escaping special characters including periods, dashes, and parentheses.
gotchas.fix_hint: Escape all reserved MarkdownV2 punctuation or switch to HTML parse_mode.

gotchas.signal: 200 OK with empty array [] despite existing records
gotchas.claim: Row Level Security (RLS) silently hides matching rows when active without matching SELECT policies, returning empty arrays instead of 403.
gotchas.fix_hint: Add an RLS SELECT policy for the authenticated/anon role or query with service_role secret.

gotchas.signal: PGRST204: Could not find a relationship
gotchas.claim: PostgREST schema cache remains stale after running direct SQL migrations until reloaded.
gotchas.fix_hint: Notify pgrst via NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema' or reboot the Supabase project schema cache.

gotchas.claim: Firestore client SDK throws permission errors for missing documents if the security rule condition evaluates to false on null data.
gotchas.fix_hint: Guard security rules with resource != null before checking nested resource attributes.

gotchas.claim: Firestore transactions throw runtime exceptions if any read operation is attempted after a write operation in the same transaction block.
gotchas.fix_hint: Structure transaction blocks so all get() calls execute before any set(), update(), or delete() calls.

gotchas.signal: 403 Forbidden: Invalid request headers (Bearer vs X-Auth-Key)
gotchas.claim: Using Authorization: Bearer with a Global API Key or X-Auth-Key with an API Token results in 403 errors.
gotchas.fix_hint: Use Authorization: Bearer only for scoped API tokens, and X-Auth-Email plus X-Auth-Key for global keys.

gotchas.signal: 200 OK with success: true on nonexistent cache purge
gotchas.claim: Cloudflare cache purge calls return success: true even if none of the specified URLs were in cache.
gotchas.fix_hint: Do not rely on cache purge responses to verify URL existence or cache state.

gotchas.claim: Serverless functions terminating past maximum execution duration are abruptly killed without returning execution error logs.
gotchas.fix_hint: Increase maxDuration in vercel.json or delegate long-running tasks to background workers.

gotchas.claim: Vercel serverless function requests and responses fail if the body payload exceeds 4.5 MB.
gotchas.fix_hint: Upload large files directly to object storage via presigned URLs instead of through Vercel functions.

gotchas.claim: Uploading to a presigned S3 URL fails if the client adds headers not specified when the URL was generated.
gotchas.fix_hint: Match HTTP headers and Content-Type exactly between presigning and client upload requests.

gotchas.signal: XML response body with status 200 on multipart completion failure
gotchas.claim: S3 completeMultipartUpload can return HTTP 200 with an internal XML error payload if an error occurs mid-assembly.
gotchas.fix_hint: Inspect the XML response body for <Error> tags even when receiving HTTP 200 OK.

gotchas.claim: Google Sheets API enforces a strict quota of 60 requests per minute per user / 300 per project.
gotchas.fix_hint: Batch updates using spreadsheets.values.batchUpdate rather than single-cell calls.

gotchas.signal: 400 Bad Request: Unable to parse range
gotchas.claim: Sheet names containing spaces or symbols fail range parsing unless enclosed in single quotes.
gotchas.fix_hint: Enclose sheet names in single quotes when constructing A1 notation strings.

gotchas.claim: Incremental calendar synchronization fails with 410 when the syncToken expires or becomes invalid.
gotchas.fix_hint: Discard the stored syncToken and initiate a full calendar resync from scratch.

gotchas.signal: 400 Bad Request: Invalid raw email string
gotchas.claim: Gmail API requires raw emails to be base64url-encoded rather than standard base64.
gotchas.fix_hint: Replace + with -, / with _, and strip trailing = padding in the base64 string.

gotchas.claim: Querying history changes with an outdated historyId returns 404 once history records are purged.
gotchas.fix_hint: Perform a complete messages.list synchronization when historyId lookup fails with 404.

gotchas.claim: Application permissions in Microsoft Entra ID fail at runtime until an administrator grants tenant-wide consent.
gotchas.fix_hint: Have a tenant admin perform Grant Admin Consent in the Azure portal for the app registration.

gotchas.signal: 400 Bad Request: Batch request limit exceeded
gotchas.claim: Microsoft Graph $batch requests fail if the requests array contains more than 20 individual operations.
gotchas.fix_hint: Chunk batch payloads into groups of 20 or fewer operations.

gotchas.signal: 400 Bad Request: ADF format required for description
gotchas.claim: Jira REST API v3 rejects plain text or markdown in rich text fields such as description.
gotchas.fix_hint: Provide content in Atlassian Document Format (ADF) JSON or use the v2 REST API.

gotchas.signal: Silent truncation of search results at 100 issues
gotchas.claim: The JQL search endpoint limits maxResults to 100 regardless of higher requested values.
gotchas.fix_hint: Paginate JQL results using startAt offsets up to the total count.

gotchas.signal: 200 OK with errors array on GraphQL mutations
gotchas.claim: Linear GraphQL mutations return HTTP 200 with validation failures embedded inside the errors payload.
gotchas.fix_hint: Check the response errors property before assuming successful mutation completion.

gotchas.claim: Linear limits API usage based on GraphQL query complexity points rather than simple request counts.
gotchas.fix_hint: Reduce nested relation selections in GraphQL queries to conserve complexity credits.

gotchas.claim: Exceeding Airtable's 5 requests per second rate limit triggers an automatic 30-second penalty lockout window.
gotchas.fix_hint: Queue requests with a minimum 200ms delay between consecutive API invocations.

gotchas.signal: 422 Unprocessable Entity: Value is not an array of record IDs
gotchas.claim: Setting linked record fields requires an array of record ID strings rather than record names or single strings.
gotchas.fix_hint: Wrap record IDs in an array like ["recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"] when updating linked fields.

gotchas.claim: Shopify REST API throttles clients using a leaky bucket algorithm once the call limit bucket fills.
gotchas.fix_hint: Read the X-Shopify-Shop-Api-Call-Limit header and sleep when current calls approach the bucket capacity.

gotchas.signal: Webhook HMAC verification failure with parsed JSON
gotchas.claim: Validating X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256 fails if computed against a JSON-re-encoded string instead of the raw request buffer.
gotchas.fix_hint: Calculate the HMAC directly against the raw unparsed request body buffer.

gotchas.claim: Attempting to capture an order before the customer completes authentication via the redirect URL throws ORDER_NOT_APPROVED.
gotchas.fix_hint: Ensure the payer has authorized the order and returned to your return_url before calling capture.

gotchas.signal: 401 Unauthorized: Invalid client credentials in wrong environment
gotchas.claim: Sandbox client credentials fail with 401 when used against the production api-m.paypal.com endpoint.
gotchas.fix_hint: Toggle between api-m.sandbox.paypal.com and api-m.paypal.com based on credential environment.

gotchas.claim: Plaid items frequently enter ITEM_LOGIN_REQUIRED when institutions invalidate sessions or require MFA.
gotchas.fix_hint: Trigger Plaid Link in update mode with a new link_token to allow users to re-authenticate.

gotchas.claim: Calling /transactions/get immediately after Link exchange fails if initial transaction syncing is still in progress.
gotchas.fix_hint: Listen for the SYNC_UPDATES_AVAILABLE or HISTORICAL_UPDATE webhook before pulling transactions.

gotchas.signal: 429 Too Many Requests on public free tier
gotchas.claim: CoinGecko enforces an aggressive rate limit of 10-30 calls per minute on free public tier endpoints.
gotchas.fix_hint: Cache cryptocurrency price data locally for at least 60 seconds per asset.

gotchas.signal: 404 Not Found: Could not find coin with the given id
gotchas.claim: CoinGecko endpoints require unique coin slugs (e.g. 'bitcoin') rather than ticker symbols (e.g. 'BTC').
gotchas.fix_hint: Map ticker symbols to CoinGecko IDs using the /coins/list endpoint before querying prices.

gotchas.claim: Etherscan returns HTTP 200 with an embedded status: 0 error string when the 5 calls/sec rate limit is exceeded.
gotchas.fix_hint: Inspect the status and message properties inside the 200 OK body before parsing result.

gotchas.signal: 429 Too Many Requests: Your app has exceeded its compute units per second capacity
gotchas.claim: Alchemy rates calls by Compute Units (CUs) rather than raw request counts, so heavy RPC calls trigger 429 quickly.
gotchas.fix_hint: Limit block range widths in eth_getLogs queries to reduce CU burn per call.

gotchas.claim: Newly created OpenWeatherMap API keys take up to 2 hours to activate globally after registration.
gotchas.fix_hint: Wait 1 to 2 hours after key generation before dispatching weather requests.

gotchas.claim: Google Maps APIs return HTTP 200 with status REQUEST_DENIED if billing is not activated on the GCP project.
gotchas.fix_hint: Attach an active billing account to the GCP project in Google Cloud Console.

gotchas.claim: Geocoding searches yielding no matches return HTTP 200 with ZERO_RESULTS rather than HTTP 404.
gotchas.fix_hint: Check the status field in the JSON payload before reading results array entries.

gotchas.signal: 403 Forbidden: Missing User-Agent or default script header
gotchas.claim: Nominatim unconditionally blocks generic User-Agents such as python-requests, curl, or empty headers.
gotchas.fix_hint: Set a custom User-Agent identifying your specific application and contact email.

gotchas.claim: Sending more than 1 request per second to public Nominatim results in immediate temporary IP ban.
gotchas.fix_hint: Throttle calls strictly to at least 1100ms between requests.

gotchas.claim: Open-Meteo returns time series as separate parallel arrays (time: [], temperature: []) rather than an array of objects.
gotchas.fix_hint: Zip the time array and metric arrays together by matching index client-side.

gotchas.claim: Setting search_depth to 'advanced' silently consumes 2 API credits per query instead of 1.
gotchas.fix_hint: Default search_depth to 'basic' unless deep research content extraction is strictly needed.

gotchas.claim: Exa requires authentication via the x-api-key header rather than Authorization: Bearer.
gotchas.fix_hint: Pass API credentials in the x-api-key header.

gotchas.signal: Empty text results unless contents is specified
gotchas.claim: Exa search endpoints return only URLs and metadata by default unless contents: { text: true } is explicitly passed.
gotchas.fix_hint: Include contents: { text: true } in the request payload to retrieve article contents.

gotchas.claim: The crawl endpoint returns a job ID immediately rather than parsed web content.
gotchas.fix_hint: Poll the crawl status endpoint until status equals 'completed' before retrieving pages.

gotchas.signal: 200 OK with {"error": "Google hasn't returned any results"}
gotchas.claim: SerpApi returns HTTP 200 with an error attribute for empty or failed search results.
gotchas.fix_hint: Check for the error key in response JSON before accessing organic_results.

gotchas.signal: Actor run returns RUNNING status before dataset is populated
gotchas.claim: Triggering an Apify Actor returns execution metadata immediately without waiting for items to be scraped.
gotchas.fix_hint: Append waitForFinish parameter or poll the dataset endpoint after actor completion.

gotchas.signal: 400 Bad Request: Vector dimension does not match index dimension
gotchas.claim: Upserting vectors with dimensional lengths differing from index initialization parameters fails outright.
gotchas.fix_hint: Verify your embedding model output dimensions match the Pinecone index dimension setting.

gotchas.claim: Pinecone namespaces cannot be created via the control plane and only exist once vectors are upserted into them.
gotchas.fix_hint: Write vectors directly to the desired namespace name to instantiate it.

gotchas.signal: 400 Bad Request: Index required for payload schema filtering
gotchas.claim: Filtering large collections by payload keys fails or degrades severely unless a payload index is created on that key.
gotchas.fix_hint: Create a payload index on frequently queried metadata fields before running filtered searches.

gotchas.signal: 422 Unprocessable Entity: Class name must start with an uppercase letter
gotchas.claim: Weaviate schemas enforce that collection and class names begin with a capital letter.
gotchas.fix_hint: Capitalize the first letter of all class/collection names in schema definitions.

gotchas.claim: ElevenLabs counts all characters including whitespace and punctuation toward quota, cutting off requests instantly when zeroed.
gotchas.fix_hint: Track character length client-side and verify subscription balance before dispatching voice synthesis.

gotchas.signal: 400 Bad Request: Bad audio encoding parameters
gotchas.claim: Supplying encoding or sample_rate query parameters when uploading pre-encoded container formats like MP3 causes rejection.
gotchas.fix_hint: Omit encoding and sample_rate parameters when sending containerized audio like MP3 or WAV.

gotchas.claim: Creating a prediction returns status 'starting' and requires polling urls.get unless a webhook is configured.
gotchas.fix_hint: Poll the prediction status URL or supply a webhook parameter for asynchronous notification.

gotchas.signal: 503 Service Unavailable: Model ... is currently loading
gotchas.claim: Inference API calls on cold models return 503 with an estimated_time wait duration.
gotchas.fix_hint: Inspect estimated_time, sleep for the suggested interval, or pass x-wait-for-model: true header.

gotchas.signal: 403 Forbidden: Access to model is restricted
gotchas.claim: Gated models (e.g. Llama) reject API tokens until license terms are accepted on the web UI.
gotchas.fix_hint: Visit the Hugging Face model repository page and accept the licensing terms.

gotchas.signal: 400 Bad Request: Invalid message alternation for tool calls
gotchas.claim: Mistral rejects conversation payloads where assistant tool_calls are not followed immediately by matching tool role messages.
gotchas.fix_hint: Format tool execution outputs with role: 'tool' directly following the assistant tool_calls message.

gotchas.signal: 429 Too Many Requests: Rate limit reached for model ... on tokens per minute (TPM)
gotchas.claim: Extremely fast generation speeds cause rapid exhaustion of TPM allowances before RPM limits are approached.
gotchas.fix_hint: Implement client-side rate limit queues based on response token counts.

gotchas.claim: Default quota is 10,000 units/day, and search.list consumes 100 units per call, exhausting the quota in 100 calls.
gotchas.fix_hint: Cache search results aggressively and prefer low-cost methods like videos.list (1 unit).

gotchas.signal: 429 Too Many Requests / 403 Forbidden on missing custom User-Agent
gotchas.claim: Reddit API blocks requests using generic User-Agents or standard HTTP client defaults.
gotchas.fix_hint: Set User-Agent to <platform>:<app_id>:<version> (by /u/<username>) format.

gotchas.signal: 400 Bad Request with error_subcode 463: Session has expired
gotchas.claim: User access tokens expire silently without refresh token grant flows, requiring re-authorization.
gotchas.fix_hint: Exchange short-lived tokens for 60-day long-lived tokens via oauth/access_token.

gotchas.signal: 401 Unauthorized on API token auth without /token suffix
gotchas.claim: Using API tokens in Zendesk Basic Auth requires appending /token to the username email.
gotchas.fix_hint: Pass credentials as username@example.com/token:<api_token> in the Authorization header.

gotchas.claim: Standard offset pagination in Zendesk search stops working beyond 1,000 records.
gotchas.fix_hint: Switch to cursor-based pagination for datasets exceeding 1,000 entries.

gotchas.claim: Omitting the Intercom-Version header causes the API to default to legacy workspace schema versions.
gotchas.fix_hint: Explicitly pass Intercom-Version: 2.11 in all API request headers.

gotchas.signal: 401 Unauthorized / Connection error from wrong datacenter domain
gotchas.claim: Mailchimp API calls fail if directed to the wrong datacenter subdomain prefix.
gotchas.fix_hint: Extract the datacenter prefix from the API key suffix (e.g. us19) and use <dc>.api.mailchimp.com.

gotchas.signal: 400 Bad Request: Member In Compliance State
gotchas.claim: Re-subscribing an unsubscribed email address directly via API fails for user compliance reasons.
gotchas.fix_hint: Set status to 'pending' to trigger a double opt-in confirmation email.

gotchas.claim: Hardcoding DocuSign production base endpoints fails because accounts are hosted on dynamic regional base URIs.
gotchas.fix_hint: Call /oauth/userinfo after authentication to dynamically retrieve the account's base_uri.

gotchas.claim: Sentry rate limits ingestion per category (error, transaction, session) using custom header rate limits.
gotchas.fix_hint: Parse X-Sentry-Rate-Limit to identify which specific event category must back off.

gotchas.claim: Many Datadog endpoints require both DD-API-KEY and DD-APPLICATION-KEY headers and reject calls with only an API key.
gotchas.fix_hint: Supply both DD-API-KEY and DD-APPLICATION-KEY headers on administrative endpoints.

gotchas.claim: Directing API requests to datadoghq.com for EU or US5 hosted accounts results in 403 Forbidden.
gotchas.fix_hint: Set API hostname to match the account site (e.g. api.datadoghq.eu or api.us5.datadoghq.com).

gotchas.claim: PagerDuty REST API v2 rejects standard Bearer token formatting for account API tokens.
gotchas.fix_hint: Format the Authorization header strictly as 'Token token=<API_KEY>'.

gotchas.claim: Creating or modifying incidents via the REST API fails without a From header containing a valid user email.
gotchas.fix_hint: Include a From header set to the email address of a registered PagerDuty user.
